positive_snippets:
Staff was co-operative and humble room is spacious and ventilated .
Room was neat and clean good for corporates stay
It is a nice hotel. We have taken a room with a balcony. It is a very nice room and the view is also very nice.
negative_snippets:
The hotel is by the side of the main road so expect a lot of traffic noise.
The standard of rooms is very low and can be easily brought up.
The sofa was broken, no chairs, dirty mattress and pillows, no towels or slippers, no amenities and not even handwash was present in the room.
The TV in the room didnt have a remote.

The only upside was that the bathrooms were neat and clean nd geyser was working. The staff though initially seemed disinterested was responsive when asked for a change of pillows (they sent a cushion instead) 🤣

Overall I am thankful for the hotel since I was in desperate need of a stay and they had rooms but if given a choice I would not want to stay there ever again.
